content: {"episode_id":"ep-05043","cpt":"93229","denial_carc":"CO-197","necessity_paragraph":"We appeal the CO-197 denial of mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229), acknowledging that prior authorization is missing. The clinical indication note documents recurrent palpitations, lightheadedness, and intermittent syncope suggestive of symptomatic atrial fibrillation and sick sinus syndrome. Given the history of unexplained cardiac arrhythmias and the need to correlate symptoms with rhythm disturbances, mobile cardiac telemetry was ordered to capture continuous electrocardiographic data during daily activities."}
